name: Ferdinand de Saussure
shortBio: Swiss linguist and philosopher recognized as the founder of modern linguistics and semiology. Established that linguistic signs are arbitrary and meaning emerges from differential relations within a closed system.
centralQuestion: How do arbitrary linguistic signs generate meaning purely through differences within a formal system rather than reference to external reality?

keyWorks.title: Course in General Linguistics
keyWorks.description: Foundational text of structuralism and semiology, establishing the distinction between langue and parole, and the signifier and signified.

keyWorks.title: Memoir on the Primitive System of Vowels in the Indo-European Languages
keyWorks.description: Groundbreaking comparative philological work reconstructing Proto-Indo-European vowel systems using structural algebraic methods.
